description.sub_name: 建築材料綜合性理解與應用
description.sub_ename: COMPREHENSIVELY UNDERSTAND BUILDING MATERIALS AND THE APPLICATIONS
description.describe_ch: 本課程著重於建築材料特性認識、設計運用、施工與組裝。重點課程1/4著重於鋼材設計到製造與安裝過程、1/4著重於預拌混凝土材料特性與設計到模板組裝與施工、1/4著重於木結構與其它環保建材特性與施工組裝、1/4著重於實際操作或實地參訪，為課程四大主軸。
description.describe_eh:
The course intends to teach in-depth knowledge of building materials, from material characteristics, design application, and construction to assembly. 
The proposed course is divided into four parts, with 1/4 of the course will be focusing on steel design, fabrication to assembly, 1/4 on concrete construction, panel assembly, and on-site casting process, 1/4 focusing on the wooden structure typology and other sustainable building materials and assembly, and the last 1/4 of the course focus on-site learning via field trip or experiment.

targets.describe_ch: 介紹建築業界國內外常見建築材料
targets.describe_en: Be able to understand national and international common building materials and its characteristics.

targets.describe_ch: 理解建築業界主流使用材料與應用範圍
targets.describe_en: Be able to comprehend the key building materials and its characteristics.

targets.describe_ch: 應用所學建築材料知識在工程細節圖上
targets.describe_en: Be able to apply the comprehend knowledge of the building materials and its characteristics to architecture design and construction document detail.

targets.describe_ch: 綜合性瞭解建築業界主流使用材料與應用範圍
targets.describe_en: Be able to synthesize the key building materials and its characteristics.

targets.describe_ch: 理解國內外永續發展趨勢與新型材料
targets.describe_en: Be able to comprehend the key global and national sustainable building material movements and newly developed materials.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. 成績相關規定
    1. 期中、期末會依時間線上公佈成績。(Midterm and the final result will post on the school’s learning platform)
    2. 期末須將學期指定成果上傳至雲端繳交，包含設計定案圖說及報告書等相關資料，未繳交者扣總分10分。(Specific coursework will be requested to upload onto an online platform. If a student fails to upload the requested file at the end of the semester, one whole letter grade drops)
  2. 期中與末成績:
    1. 期中與期末成績不及格時，一律不接受『補交與補考』。(If a student fails the midterm or the final, no make-up exam or equivalent will be issued)
    2. 期中與期末考試請假『僅限』重大事故，須出示證明文件，並須在規定時間內提完成補考與補件給予分數。逾時視同放棄。(If a student missed the midterm or the final due to unforeseen events, only the university's acceptable excuses will be accepted. The student must provide the document promptly)
  3. 本學期此課額外花費與注意事項:
    1. 學期中『者』會有額外共同花費，包含移地教學交通車費用等相關花費。所有費用計算與收據會線上透明公開，並且由老師與學生一起平分。 如無參加移地教學的學生，不需要分擔共同花費，但會被扣分與失去繳交移地教學相關作業權利。(This course may have extra costs, including field trips and traveling expenses.   4. 移地教學地點及目的 (學期拜訪地點至少三個):
    1. 潤弘精密工程事業股份有限公司/ 桃園
      目的:觀看建築實際預鑄過程與上課教材連結。
      Field Trip: Ruentex Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd. / Taoyuan
      Objective: Observe the course's precasting process and teach content in practice.
    2. 亞東預拌混凝土/台中市工業區
      目的:觀看預拌混凝土過程及材料測試與上課教材連結。
      Field Trip: Yatung Ready-Mixed Concrete / Taichung Industrial Park
      Objective: Observing the course's concrete mixture and teaching content in practice. 
    3. 信暐鋼構股份有限公司/彰化溪湖 
      目的:觀看建築鋼鐵結構製造過程與上課教材連結。
      Field Trip: Shin Wei Steel Structure Co., Ltd. / Xihu, Changhua
      ​​​​​​​Objective: Observe the course's steel structure-making process and teaching content in practice.

policy.ais_meno:
1. 報告書內容超過30%與既有論文、網路文章等相關資訊來源，一律視為不及格。(If a student’s report content exceeds more than 30% plagiarized existing journal articles, online articles, or other resources, the student will fail that report assignment)
  2. 報告書內容超過30%透過ChatGPT等相關AI工具來源，一律視為不及格。(If a student’s report content exceeds more than 30% generated from ChatGPT or other AI tool resources, the student will fail that report assignment)
  3. 報告書內容若有AI生成文字、圖片與影片皆必須註明。(If a student’s report contains text, pictures, and video generated from AI tools, all material must be properly cited)
  4. 報告書內容超過5項引用，但是沒有註明，一律視為不及格。(If a student’s report content exceeds more than 5 references that are not correctly cited, the student will fail that report assignment)
  5. 考試作弊或是干擾考試秩序，一律視為不及格。(If a student cheats or disrupts an exam, the student will fail that exam)
